## Summary

**PANDN** (Vector and not): Bitwise logical operation, vea bits get flipped before logical “and” operation. Result is stored in d.

## Details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Operation | `64x (not a ) & b → d` |
| Syntax | `PANDN <vea>,b,d` |
| Short | Bitwise logical operation, vea bits get flipped before logical “and” operation. Result is stored in d. |
| Condition codes | not affected |

### Encoding

| Word | Bits | Content |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 15–9 | `1111111` |
| 1 | 8 | A |
| 1 | 7 | B |
| 1 | 6 | D |
| 1 | 5–3 | Mode |
| 1 | 2–0 | Register |
| 2 | 15–12 | b |
| 2 | 11–8 | d |
| 2 | 7–0 | `00001011` |

### Example

```asm
    pandn    d0,d1,d2
```

```text
vea d0: 12 FF 12 FF 00 FF 00 FF
b d1: 12 12 FF FF 00 00 FF FF
Result:
d d2: 00 00 ED 00 00 00 FF 00
```

## Differences from AmigaOS / AROS / 68060

- The 68000–68060 have no PANDN. It is new on the 68080.

## Do / Don't

- No rules beyond the details above.
